attempts.summary: Installed and configured a persistent iptables/ip6tables host firewall on node1 (Alpine Linux) that accepts SSH (22) and TCP 8080, allows loopback/established traffic and ICMP echo, and rejects all other inbound connections with icmp-port-unreachable. Rules were saved via OpenRC (/etc/iptables/rules-save, /etc/iptables/rules6-save) and the iptables/ip6tables services were added to the default runlevel. Verified functionally before and after a full node reboot (new boot_id confirmed a real restart), with firewall rules, service state, and SSH all recovering automatically and correctly.
